From: AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>

Cc: procurement@cloudtail.io
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace: technical & billing questionnaire for SaaS listing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for initiating the AWS Marketplace listing conversation. Attached is the vendor onboarding questionnaire we need completed to move your SaaS listing through our procurement and billing teams. High-level asks:

- Architecture diagram for SaaS offering (multi-tenant isolation and tenancy model).
- Billing integration approach (metering, usage reporting, billing IDs).
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC 2, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS/HSM usage).
- Support and SLA overview for marketplace customers.
- Reseller/partner onboarding details (CloudTail will handle channel transaction model).

Please return the completed questionnaire and any supporting evidence (controls matrix, cert PDFs) within 5 business days so we can proceed to legal and listing verification.

Attachments: aws_marketplace_questionnaire.xlsx (fillable)

If you prefer, we can take these answers in a 30-minute call and I can upload the files on your behalf.

Best,
Emma Park
AWS Marketplace Onboarding
aws-marketplace@amazon.com

Priyom / Lauren — quick first pass and inline notes. I attached a draft PDF of our answers (RFI_answers_v1.pdf). Highlights / suggestions: 

- Architecture / tenancy: propose "logical multi-tenancy with strong tenant isolation". Call out per-tenant namespaces, quotas, and customer-specific encryption keys where needed. Note that default run mode is shared multi-tenant; dedicated deployments are available under Dedicated plan.
- KMS/HSM: we use customer-managed KMS keys (optional) or Redwood-managed KMS for convenience. For marketplace listing, state support for CMKs (AWS KMS) and optional HSM-backed keys for on-prem/private deployments.
- SOC2 / certs: include SOC2 Type II report summary + link to security_evidence_summary.pdf; we'll not attach full report until executed NDA/contract.
- Billing / metering: recommend listing as "metered SaaS" with usage dimensions: inference_tokens, embedding_units, and dedicated_capacity_hours. Lauren to confirm exact meter names.
- Onboarding flow for CloudTail: propose chargeback via partner-managed subscriptions; CloudTail collects and remits per agreement (they provided high level).

Small wording suggestions for questionnaire: be explicit that we provide per-route latency SLOs and fallback model variants for high-availability. Also note caching prefix options (helps billing predictability).

I'll also note the API endpoints for metering callbacks (do not publish keys in questionnaire).

Attachments: RFI_answers_v1.pdf, security_evidence_summary.pdf

Karthik
Head of Platform Product
Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom / Karthik / Lauren,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft answers — this is helpful. A couple of next steps:

- Please upload the completed questionnaire (final workbook) and the security evidence PDF to the shared Drive link we provided. If you prefer, I can accept the PDF and upload the completed workbook on your behalf after our review call.
- We need to schedule a 30-minute technical verification call (architecture + billing signals). Please propose 3 slots; we prefer Sep 16 or 17 (PST).
- Legal will send a short DocuSign listing addendum after we confirm the final meter names and pricing model. I included a placeholder here: https://app.docusign.com/US/12345abcdef

One request on evidence: if you can provide the SOC2 cover letter and an encryption-at-rest architecture slide (1 page) that speeds review. You can redact customer names.

I'll loop in Marketplace Ops for final listing verification once we receive the workbook.

Best,
Emma Park
